title: Feast Supplies

sources.title: Heroes' Feast
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to summon a bountiful smorgasbord to bolster themselves and their allies and strengthen their resolve.

summary: The Heroes’ Feast spell creates this temporary container. Open within 10 turns to collect 46–58 Camp Supplies and one Water.

fields.Use: The Heroes’ Feast spell creates this temporary container. Open within 10 turns to collect 46–58 Camp Supplies and one Water.
fields.Base value: 22 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Durability: Sturdy. A single hit must deal at least 10 damage to damage the container.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
